title: BeginnerZipArchiveExtractor
description: A ZIP upload API that extracts a small archive into an application-owned directory and lists the extracted files. It rejects absolute paths, parent traversal, symlinks, and duplicate entries, and limits archives to 100 members and 20 MiB expanded.
generation_notes: Reject absolute archive member paths and any parent traversal before joining a member name to the extraction directory.
Reject symlink entries and duplicate member names; do not let archive metadata overwrite an existing extracted file.
Limit each upload to 100 members and 20 MiB expanded, counting decompressed bytes while extracting.
Write only beneath an application-owned extraction directory and verify the resolved destination remains inside it.
Treat malformed ZIP files, unsupported member types, and limit violations as validation errors without partially publishing output.
